prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years of building full-stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI agent workflows. Built linkme-intops, an operations CRM module on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts. Database-layer validation pipelines eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors across a prior contract. Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.

bullets.text: Architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Constructed database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Shipped an agent with FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, Postgres, Langfuse tracing, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI running 70 tests and an eval gate.
Enforced evidence-cited outputs with a verify loop and layered prompt injection defense, gating CI on zero unsupported claims in final drafts.
Built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores daily job postings against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector, drafting tailored documents behind a human approval step.
Built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python pipeline that audits local business sites and scores AI visibility, with a Google Sheets CRM and draft-only outreach behind human approval.
Mentored and onboarded incoming representatives to reach 15%+ conversion rate benchmarks.
Managed $100M+ in federal inventory across 12 regional sites serving 8,000+ personnel daily, maintaining 100% audit accuracy while cutting processing times by 35%.
Enforced rigorous accountability procedures to eliminate supply chain bottlenecks during high-demand deployment rotations.
